correctness.rationale: For any finite nonempty G, define Y=Ind(mu(G)-w) and S the full shadow simplex. Sending every original v to shadow v_prime, fixing shadows, defines a simplicial retraction p:Y->S; for any independent face F, F union p(F) remains independent because each old-shadow forbidden adjacency corresponds to an original forbidden adjacency. Therefore id_Y and inclusion p are contiguous, giving an Aut(G)-equivariant strong deformation retract, and S contracts equivariantly to its symmetric barycenter. The apex cone piece w*Ind(G) glues to Y along Ind(G); the equivariant homotopy pushout is the unreduced suspension with fixed poles. Iterate under natural lifted automorphisms; equivariant homotopy equivalence commutes with subgroup fixed spaces and quotients. Orbit-barycenter weights give exact PL fixed model. In C5, base pentagon has no rotation/full D5 fixed point, exactly two reflection points and interval dihedral quotient, yielding r-step fixed spheres and contractible orbit quotient. Includes empty fixed base via the double-cone convention.
